messages.author: cbdcfbdbf92e1f41
messages.subject: R shiny 0.8 and Rcpp 0.11
parts:
After I update Rcpp to 0.11, I had this error message when I load library(shiny)

Is there anything that I can do to fix this problem. Thank you in advance.

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : unable to load shared object '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/httpuv/libs/httpuv.so': libRcpp.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘shiny’ Execution halted

messages.author: 61ec521265480c25
messages.subject: R shiny 0.8 and Rcpp 0.11
parts: I think there was a warning in the Rcpp news file that packages importing it need to be reinstalled.
